prompt:
## Resumo
A premium dark glassmorphism sign-up screen: a single full-viewport hero that doubles as the auth surface, set over an animated aurora gradient + film-grain backdrop under a translucent sticky nav. A mx-auto max-w-6xl grid splits the hero into two columns: the LEFT is a marketing pitch (a 'no card' trial pill, a big Space Grotesk display headline with a teal-to-magenta gradient accent line 'speed of thought.', a value paragraph, a three-item teal-check benefit list, and a stacked-avatar + 4.9-star social-proof cluster) and the RIGHT is a frosted-glass account-creation card with a gradient edge-light: Google + GitHub social buttons in a 2-col grid above an 'or with email' divider, then full-name / email / password fields (icon-leading, with a Show/Hide password toggle), a four-segment password-strength meter, and a teal-to-magenta gradient 'Create account' CTA, plus a Terms/Privacy footnote and a 'Sign in' link beneath the card. A full-bleed glass 'Trusted by' logo strip closes the screen. Aurora-on-near-black glassmorphism aesthetic (teal #2dd4bf + magenta #e879f9 accents on ink #0b0f14), Inter body + Space Grotesk display.

## Estilo Visual
Premium dark glassmorphism sign-up + landing screen. Background canvas ink #0b0f14 (color-scheme dark). Behind everything: a fixed full-bleed .aurora layer = a blurred (blur 42px, saturate 155%) stack of five radial gradients in teal #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9 and aqua #5eead4 at varying positions/opacities, slowly drifting on a 22s alternating drift keyframe (translate3d + scale 1->1.08); above it a fixed .grain layer = a top-down vignette (radial transparent->rgba(5,7,10,.55)) plus a tiled SVG fractal-noise texture at 0.04 opacity. Surfaces are frosted glass: .glass = a 155deg linear-gradient of rgba(255,255,255,.11)->rgba(255,255,255,.025), backdrop-blur 26px saturate 130%, 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12) border; .glass-sheen adds an inner top-edge highlight (a 180deg white->transparent overlay + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18) box-shadow); the nav uses .glass-nav = rgba(11,15,20,.55) + backdrop-blur 16px. The auth card adds .card-glow = a masked 135deg teal->magenta->transparent 1px gradient ring around the border (opacity .7). Two accent hues: teal #2dd4bf (primary) and magenta #e879f9 (secondary), with aqua #5eead4 in gradients. Tailwind theme colors: ink #0b0f14, aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9. Typefaces (Google Fonts): Inter (sans, weights 400/500/600/700) for body/UI and Space Grotesk (display, weights 500/600/700) for headlines + the brand wordmark; antialiased, optimizeLegibility. Inputs (.field) = rgba(255,255,255,.045) fill, 1px rgba(255,255,255,.10) border, placeholder rgba(226,232,240,.42); on focus they glow teal (background rgba(45,212,191,.06), border rgba(45,212,191,.65), box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,.14) + 0 0 28px rgba(45,212,191,.22)) and the leading icon turns teal #2dd4bf. The primary CTA (.btn-grad) = a 105deg teal #2dd4bf -> aqua #5eead4 -> magenta #e879f9 gradient with a dual teal/magenta drop glow, dark ink text, hover translate-y -1px + brightness 1.05. .grad-text = a 100deg aqua->teal->magenta gradient clipped to text. Icons via Iconify (Phosphor 'ph:*' set, logos:google-icon, mdi:github). Calm motion only: the 22s aurora drift and a pulsing trial-pill dot. Voice is warm and human ('Design at the speed of thought.', 'Turn a sentence into shippable UI.'), zero em-dashes.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
A fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 header using .glass-nav (background rgba(11,15,20,.55) + backdrop-blur 16px saturate 140%) over a 1px border-b border-white/10. Inner nav is mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 (lg:px-10), 64px tall (h-16), flex items-center justify-between. LEFT: a brand lockup = a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl .btn-grad tile (the teal-to-magenta gradient) holding a dark-ink ph:sparkle-fill glyph, beside a Space Grotesk font-700 18px tracking-tight white 'Nebula' wordmark. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex): four nav links 'Product' / 'Templates' / 'Pricing' / 'Docs' at 14px slate-300, hover white. RIGHT: a 'Sign in' text link (hidden below sm, slate-300) and a .chip rounded-full px-4 py-2 'Start free' pill (translucent white fill + hairline border, font-500 white, hover bg-white/10).

### Hero shell + aurora background
Two fixed full-bleed background layers sit at the very back: a .aurora layer (z-0) = five blurred drifting radial gradients in teal/magenta/aqua on a 22s drift keyframe, and a .grain layer (z-1, pointer-events-none) = a top-down vignette + a tiled SVG fractal-noise texture at .04 opacity. The hero is a relative z-10 main (id 'signup') holding a section that is min-h-screen, pt-28 pb-20 px-6, flex items-center. Its inner container is mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl, a grid that is one column by default and lg:grid-cols-2 with gap-14 (lg:gap-10), items-center.

### Hero LEFT — marketing pitch
A max-w-lg column (mx-auto lg:mx-0), center-aligned on mobile and left-aligned at lg. Top to bottom: (1) a .chip trial pill = inline-flex rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5, 12px font-500 text-aqua/90, with a 6px pulsing teal dot (animate-pulse) and the text '14-day Pro trial . no card'. (2) A Space Grotesk font-700 white headline, text-[2.6rem] leading-[1.05] (sm:text-5xl lg:text-[3.4rem]) tracking-tight: 'Design at the' then a line break and a .grad-text accent 'speed of thought.' (the aqua-teal-magenta gradient clipped to text). (3) An mt-5 slate-400 lead paragraph at 16px (sm:18px) leading-relaxed: 'Turn a sentence into shippable UI. Join 57,000 builders shaping interfaces on an infinite, AI-native canvas.'. (4) An mt-8 space-y-3.5 benefit list (inline-block text-left) of three rows, each a flex items-center gap-3 14px slate-300 line led by a teal ph:check-circle-fill glyph ('Prompt to production-ready mockups in seconds', '1,200+ curated prompt-library starting points', 'Drives your coding agent straight from the canvas'). (5) An mt-10 social-proof cluster (flex items-center gap-4, justify-center on mobile / lg:justify-start): a -space-x-2.5 stack of four 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-full ring-2 ring-ink gradient avatar chips (teal->teal-400, magenta->fuchsia-400, sky-400->aqua, fuchsia-400->magenta) beside a 12px slate-400 rating line = an amber-300 ph:star-fill + a bold slate-300 '4.9' + 'from 2,300+ designers'.

### Hero RIGHT — frosted glass auth card
A w-full max-w-md column (mx-auto). The card = .card-glow .glass .glass-sheen, relative rounded-3xl, p-7 (sm:p-9), with a deep shadow shadow-[0_40px_120px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,.85)] (the .card-glow draws a masked teal->magenta gradient edge-light around the border; the .glass-sheen draws an inner top-edge highlight). Top to bottom: (1) a centered mb-7 heading block = a Space Grotesk font-700 24px (sm:1.7rem) white tracking-tight 'Create your account' over a 14px slate-400 'Start building in under a minute.'. (2) SOCIAL block = a grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 of two .social-btn .glass buttons (each rounded-xl h-11 flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5, 14px font-500 slate-200, hover border-white/28 + bg-white/6 + translate-y -1px): a logos:google-icon + 'Google' and a white mdi:github + 'GitHub'. (3) An 'or with email' divider (my-6 flex items-center gap-4: a flex-1 1px bg-white/10 rule, an uppercase tracking-[0.2em] 0.7rem slate-500 label, another rule). (4) A form space-y-4 of three icon-leading .field inputs, each a relative .field-wrap with an absolute left-4 centered leading icon (slate-400, turns teal on focus-within): a ph:user 'Full name' text input, a ph:envelope-simple 'you@studio.com' email input, and a ph:lock-simple 'Create a password' password input that has a right-aligned 12px font-600 teal 'Show'/'Hide' toggle button (toggles input type, hover magenta); all inputs are w-full rounded-xl h-12 pl-11, 14px slate-100. (5) A four-segment password-strength meter = a flex items-center gap-1.5 of four 1px-tall flex-1 rounded-full bars (the first two filled bg-aqua/80, the last two bg-white/10) plus an 0.7rem slate-400 'Decent' label. (6) The primary CTA = a .btn-grad w-full rounded-xl h-12 mt-2, font-600 dark-ink 14px, flex items-center justify-center gap-2, 'Create account' + a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold icon. (7) An mt-5 centered 0.72rem slate-500 legal footnote 'By signing up you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.' (the two links slate-300, hover teal, underlined). BELOW the card: an mt-6 centered 14px slate-400 line 'Already have an account?' with a font-600 .grad-text 'Sign in' link.

### Trust strip (full-bleed glass)
A relative section, border-t border-white/10, bg-white/[0.015]. Inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10. A centered 12px uppercase tracking-[0.25em] slate-500 label 'Trusted by teams shipping fast', then a flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-12 gap-y-6 at 70% opacity of five placeholder logo lockups, each a flex items-center gap-2 Space Grotesk font-600 slate-300 18px = a duotone Iconify glyph (ph:cube-duotone / ph:planet-duotone / ph:lightning-duotone / ph:diamond-duotone / ph:hexagon-duotone) + a name (Vectorly / Orbit / Flux Labs / Prism / Northstar).

### Responsive reflow
The hero container is mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl; the nav is mx-auto max-w-7xl. Above lg the hero is a two-column grid (left pitch left-aligned + right glass card, items-center, lg:gap-10); below lg it collapses to a single column where the pitch becomes center-aligned and stacks above the max-w-md card. The nav center links (Product/Templates/Pricing/Docs) are hidden below md; the 'Sign in' nav link is hidden below sm (the 'Start free' chip stays). The social buttons stay a 2-col grid; the trust-strip logos wrap (flex-wrap). No horizontal overflow at 390px (the headline drops to text-[2.6rem], the card fits within px-6).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Frosted-glass auth card: a rounded-3xl .glass card with a backdrop-blur frosted fill, a masked teal-to-magenta gradient edge-light (.card-glow) and an inner top-edge sheen highlight (.glass-sheen), floating over the aurora

### Componente
Animated two-color aurora background: a fixed full-bleed stack of five blurred teal/magenta/aqua radial gradients slowly drifting on a 22s alternating keyframe, under a film-grain + vignette overlay

### Componente
Sticky translucent glass nav (.glass-nav: rgba(11,15,20,.55) + backdrop-blur over a hairline border-b)

### Componente
Email-first form with social SSO on top: a 2-col Google/GitHub grid above an 'or with email' divider, then icon-leading Full name / Email / Password fields

### Componente
Teal focus-glow inputs: .field inputs that on focus shift to a teal-tinted fill, a teal border and a dual teal box-shadow (0 0 0 3px + 0 0 28px), with the leading icon turning teal on focus-within

### Componente
Show/Hide password toggle: an inline teal text button that flips the password input's type and its own label

### Componente
Four-segment password-strength meter (two filled aqua bars + two empty bars + a 'Decent' label)

### Componente
Teal-to-magenta gradient CTA (.btn-grad) with a dual teal/magenta drop glow, dark-ink text, hover lift + brightness

### Componente
Gradient clipped text + gradient brand mark: a 100deg aqua-teal-magenta .grad-text on the headline accent and 'Sign in' link, and a teal-to-magenta sparkle brand tile

### Componente
Stacked-avatar social proof: a -space-x-2.5 row of ring-2 ring-ink gradient avatar chips beside a 4.9-star amber rating line

### Componente
Full-bleed glass 'Trusted by' logo strip with duotone Phosphor glyph lockups

Icons via Iconify (Phosphor 'ph:*' set, logos:google-icon, mdi:github). The Show/Hide password toggle is a small inline onclick that flips the password input type. Teal is the primary action/affirmation color, magenta the secondary, blended in the gradients. The reusable prompt-library value is the FROSTED-GLASS auth card (gradient edge-light + inner sheen + teal focus-glow inputs + a password-strength meter) floating over an animated two-color aurora, with an email-first form that puts Google/GitHub SSO above the email fields, wrapped in a one-screen sign-up landing (sticky glass nav, two-column pitch+card hero, full-bleed trust strip). A centered 12px uppercase tracking-[0.25em] slate-500 label 'Trusted by teams shipping fast', then a flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-12 gap-y-6 at 70% opacity of five placeholder logo lockups, each a flex items-center gap-2 Space Grotesk font-600 slate-300 18px = a duotone Iconify glyph (ph:cube-duotone / ph:planet-duotone / ph:lightning-duotone / ph:diamond-duotone / ph:hexagon-duotone) + a name (Vectorly / Orbit / Flux Labs / Prism / Northstar).

The hero container is mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl; the nav is mx-auto max-w-7xl. Above lg the hero is a two-column grid (left pitch left-aligned + right glass card, items-center, lg:gap-10); below lg it collapses to a single column where the pitch becomes center-aligned and stacks above the max-w-md card. The nav center links (Product/Templates/Pricing/Docs) are hidden below md; the 'Sign in' nav link is hidden below sm (the 'Start free' chip stays). The social buttons stay a 2-col grid; the trust-strip logos wrap (flex-wrap). No horizontal overflow at 390px (the headline drops to text-[2.6rem], the card fits within px-6).

special_ui_components.prompt: Frosted-glass auth card: a rounded-3xl .glass card with a backdrop-blur frosted fill, a masked teal-to-magenta gradient edge-light (.card-glow) and an inner top-edge sheen highlight (.glass-sheen), floating over the aurora
Animated two-color aurora background: a fixed full-bleed stack of five blurred teal/magenta/aqua radial gradients slowly drifting on a 22s alternating keyframe, under a film-grain + vignette overlay
Sticky translucent glass nav (.glass-nav: rgba(11,15,20,.55) + backdrop-blur over a hairline border-b)
Email-first form with social SSO on top: a 2-col Google/GitHub grid above an 'or with email' divider, then icon-leading Full name / Email / Password fields

Show/Hide password toggle: an inline teal text button that flips the password input's type and its own label
Four-segment password-strength meter (two filled aqua bars + two empty bars + a 'Decent' label)
Teal-to-magenta gradient CTA (.btn-grad) with a dual teal/magenta drop glow, dark-ink text, hover lift + brightness

structured.special_notes: Built on the Tailwind CDN with a custom theme.extend: fontFamily.sans = ['Inter','system-ui','sans-serif'] and fontFamily.display = ['"Space Grotesk"','sans-serif'] (Inter weights 400;500;600;700 + Space Grotesk 500;600;700 from Google Fonts); colors ink #0b0f14, aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9 (aqua #5eead4 used in gradients via Tailwind's teal/fuchsia scales). CSS keys: :root color-scheme dark; body background #0b0f14. .aurora = fixed inset-0 z-0 with a ::before of five radial gradients (teal rgba(45,212,191,.55) at 16% 20%, magenta rgba(232,121,249,.50) at 86% 26%, teal rgba(45,212,191,.30) at 64% 90%, magenta rgba(232,121,249,.26) at 30% 82%, aqua rgba(94,234,212,.22) at 78% 70%), filter blur(42px) saturate(155%), animation drift 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate (translate3d + scale to 1.08). .grain = fixed z-1 vignette (radial transparent->rgba(5,7,10,.55)) + a tiled SVG fractalNoise data-URI at .04 opacity. .glass = linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(255,255,255,.11), rgba(255,255,255,.025)) + backdrop-filter blur(26px) saturate(130%) + 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12) border. .glass-sheen::after = a 180deg white->transparent overlay + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18). .glass-nav = rgba(11,15,20,.55) + backdrop-blur 16px saturate 140%. .card-glow::before = a masked (mask-composite exclude) 135deg rgba(45,212,191,.55)->rgba(232,121,249,.45)->transparent 1px gradient ring at opacity .7. .field:focus = background rgba(45,212,191,.06), border-color rgba(45,212,191,.65), box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,.14) + 0 0 28px rgba(45,212,191,.22); .field-wrap:focus-within .field-icon = #2dd4bf. .btn-grad = linear-gradient(105deg, #2dd4bf, #5eead4 35%, #e879f9) + a dual teal/magenta drop shadow, hover translate-y -1px + brightness 1.05. .grad-text = linear-gradient(100deg, #5eead4, #2dd4bf 30%, #e879f9) clipped to text. Icons via Iconify (Phosphor 'ph:*' set, logos:google-icon, mdi:github). The Show/Hide password toggle is a small inline onclick that flips the password input type. Teal is the primary action/affirmation color, magenta the secondary, blended in the gradients. The reusable prompt-library value is the FROSTED-GLASS auth card (gradient edge-light + inner sheen + teal focus-glow inputs + a password-strength meter) floating over an animated two-color aurora, with an email-first form that puts Google/GitHub SSO above the email fields, wrapped in a one-screen sign-up landing (sticky glass nav, two-column pitch+card hero, full-bleed trust strip). Original prompt-library product for the placeholder brand 'Nebula'. Responsive: nav center links hide below md, the 'Sign in' nav link below sm, the hero stacks to one centered column below lg, the social buttons stay a 2-col grid, no overflow at 390px.
